Backwoods Inn Santa Clarita
Backwoods Inn is a beloved, family-run historic steakhouse in the Santa Clarita Valley (Canyon Country), serving up classic American comfort food and charcoal-broiled steaks since 1968. Stepping inside feels like a true time capsule with its dim lighting, rustic 1950s farm decor, and signature sawdust-covered floors.

Drinks: An old-school onsite bar known for strong pours, classic cocktails, and dirty martinis.
